theorems.name: Submission.meanCurvature_bounded_of_stationaryAlong
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ N) = 0 → R.IsStationaryAlong N → R.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
